visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a graphic title sequence against a blurred background. A central cutout of a man in a black shirt points a finger upward while stylized red and yellow Chinese text overlays the bottom half of the frame. The lighting is flat and graphic-oriented. (2) The scene transitions to a medium shot of a man wearing a light grey cardigan over a blue button-down shirt. He is sitting at a light-colored wooden table with a grey Asus laptop open in front of him. A cartoonish female avatar with an angry expression is superimposed on the left side of the screen. The background shows a modern office setting with glass partitions and a red sign with 'TAIWAN BAR' visible. (3) A sudden cut to an aerial drone view shows a wide green agricultural field. A green tractor pulls a mechanical mower, cutting the grass and creating lighter green stripes across the darker lush vegetation under bright natural daylight. (4) Returning to the man at the desk, he is now leaning forward, gesturing with both hands in a circular motion. He looks directly into the lens with an engaging, storytelling facial expression. Large yellow text bubbles appear briefly to emphasize his words. (5) A close-up shot focuses on two bright red envelopes with gold embossed Chinese characters '吉星高照' and '大吉大利' lying on a wooden surface. Beside them sits a traditional folding fan with a floral pattern, illuminated by warm indoor lighting. (6) Back in the office, the man has a digital filter of pink blushing cheeks on his face while he smiles broadly. He leans back in his black office chair, looking relaxed and nostalgic. (7) A second man with long dark hair and a brown hoodie enters the frame from a door behind the main character. He holds a phone and gestures for the first man to follow. The first man looks resigned, closes his laptop, and stands up as the video color fades to a cinematic monochrome.
